title: Apply v4 — panel round 2 fixes: shift-hours losses, honest funnel + costs, group-chat payoff, lock-screen loop
music: Santigold - Disparate Youth (TikTok sound, starts at 'Don't look ahead')

sections.text: Time off, denied. Closing Saturday. Thirteen twenty-five an hour.
So you design a hoodie on your break, and your friends call it unrealistic.
Your first store flops. Sixty dollars, gone. That's four and a half closing hours. Your second one flops too.
So the third time, you sell it before it exists. You post the mockup three nights in a row. The third one hits. Forty people ask. Fourteen pay. You print fourteen.
After costs, that's two hundred thirty-eight dollars, and you never risked a cent.
And the friend who said unrealistic? Wants one for free.
Still closing Saturday. Just not forever.
